name: Wenna's farmyard
notes: Training level B1 (D-59): a small farmyard a morning's walk from the city. The fields are as in data/maps/village.json.

art.ground: a sunny farmyard of packed earth and patchy grass, a worn path from the yard gate at the bottom to a cottage door at the top left, scattered straw, a few dandelions

pieces.Cottage: a small whitewashed farm cottage with a mossy thatched roof, a low wooden door facing down, one small shuttered window
pieces.Coop: a little wooden hen coop on short legs with a slanted plank roof and a ramp
pieces.Haystack: a round golden haystack, loosely piled
pieces.Well: a round stone well with a little wooden roof, a windlass and a coiled rope
pieces.Bench: a weathered wooden bench, plain and low
pieces.Woodpile: a neat stack of split firewood logs

apple.name: apple tree
apple.description: An old apple tree, bent and mossy, with small green apples.
